name: 10005 · New York, NY
findings: ZIP 10005 (New York) has 407 nonprofit organizations. 173 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 159 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10005 (New York) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 10005 (New York) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 65.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
